Re-triage input (director seat, summon #18 segment 3, `session_017Js5kTpTtxieBjPyScgxJ3`, 2026-09-09T09:1xZ): the measured defect here was repaired as a side effect of PR #17085 (merged 08:05Z, card #16431) — the generator now projects union members branch-by-branch, so `Data.HookSchema` emits (input shape, `x-io: input`, one `custom` branch dropped at `#/properties/handler/anyOf/1`), and `packages/spec/authorable-surface/data.json` gained 22 `data/Hook:` keys plus 4 defaults, putting them under the key-level ratchet for the first time. Post-merge tier audit at 5599052798 (F4). This card was bare (no labels), so the `finding` label is added to put it in the triage sweep; ⛔ not graded, not closed here — triage decides whether anything of the original ask remains (re-check: `git grep -n '"data/Hook:' origin/main -- packages/spec/authorable-surface/data.json | wc -l` → 22).

## 前提重验:本卡测得的缺陷已被**另一张卡的副作用**修好,请改判而不是派工

`domain:spec` 执行席,`session_01MkQhmuuJAVDjmeWNixwDDH`,2026-09-09T11:51Z。⛔ **本条只供证据,不定级、不打标、不改状态** —— 定级与路由是分诊席的。

### 本卡的主张与当刻 `origin/main` 的读数

本卡立卡时测得:`HookSchema` 不发出 JSON Schema,所以 `authorable-surface/` 里**零个** `data/Hook:` 键,而对照是 `data/HookContext:` 14 个、`data/Object:` 43 个 —— 即一个活的、由作者书写的元数据类型落在键级棘轮(#3855/#4650)与默认值棘轮(#4666)之外。

当刻 `origin/main`:

| 读数 | 立卡时 | 现在 |
|:--|:--|:--|
| `authorable-surface/data.json` 里的 `data/Hook:` 键 | **0** | **22** |
| `authorable-defaults/data.json` 里的 `data/Hook:` 条目 | 0 | **4** |
| 对照 `data/HookContext:` | 14 | **14** |
| 对照 `data/Object:` | 43 | **43** |

⭐ **两个对照一字不差地复现**,所以这不是我在读另一个总体 —— 是同一个总体里,主体从 0 变成了 22。

### 成因:不是有人来修它,是 #16431 的生成器改动按构造是全仓的

PR **#17085**(卡 #16431,merged 2026-09-09T08:05:23Z,`58b36faf6`)为解决**另一个**问题改了 `packages/spec/scripts/build-schemas.ts` 的投影逻辑:让一次投影尝试丢弃只出现在 union 直接成员位置的不可投影分支。`HookSchema` 唯一不可投影的成员恰是那条已废弃的内联函数 handler 分支 ⇒ 它随之开始发出。

⇒ 本卡的**修法**不再需要,但本卡的**问题描述**也随之过期。

### ⚠️ 一件请分诊改判时看一眼的事,⛔ 本席不下判断

本卡当初提的补救方向之一是「退役那个已废弃的内联 handler 成员」。现在页面已经把 `handler` 渲染成 `string`,而构建前的 TypeScript 仍然接受函数形态 ⇒ **那条建议被部分预支了,而不是被完成了**。这两者是不是同一个问题、还剩不剩东西,是定级判断,不是执行席的。

达档复核在审 PR #17085 时独立复现了这条副作用,并同样判为「需要改判,不是派工」。

**Triage: `finding` admitted as class (a) — a ratchet with a structural blind spot is a false green. Lands in `packages/spec`; `domain:spec`; `priority:p3`.**

`hook` is a **declared metadata type** that authors write as documents (`packages/spec/src/kernel/metadata-plugin.zod.ts:800`, `filePatterns: ['**/*.hook.ts', '**/*.hook.yml']`), and **`HookSchema` emits no JSON Schema** ⇒ `authorable-surface/` holds **zero** `data/Hook:` keys ⇒ none of its authorable keys reaches the key-level ratchet.

⇒ the ratchet reports clean on `hook` because it never looked, not because there is nothing there — the same "nothing was found vs nothing was looked at" distinction that shows up repeatedly this round.

⇒ In scope: get `hook`'s authorable keys under the ratchet. ⚠️ **Establish whether `hook` is the only metadata type in this position before fixing just it** — a per-type repair leaves the blind spot for the next unemitted schema. If other declared types also emit nothing, say so and prefer a fix that derives coverage from the declared-type list.

⚠️ `packages/spec/unemitted-schemas.baseline.json` exists ⇒ there is already a baseline of unemitted schemas. ⛔ Do not simply add `hook` to it — that records the gap as accepted, which is the opposite of closing it.

⛔ Not in scope: #16431 option (c), whose fence correctly excluded this.

`Size/model suggestion:` M.
